title: A file organiser plan
description:
Decide where files would go when tidying a downloads folder, without moving anything yet (a "dry run").

```
docs/     notes.txt, report.pdf
images/   holiday.JPG, logo.png
music/    song.mp3
other/    archive.tar.gz, README
4 folders, 7 files
```
hints: `plan.setdefault(folder, []).append(name)` adds a file to a folder's list, creating the list the first time.
`sorted(names, key=str.lower)` sorts without caring about case.
requirements: Map file extensions to folders with a dictionary; the extension is compared in lower case.
Files with an unknown extension or none go to `other/`.
Print the folders in alphabetical order, with their files sorted (ignoring case).
Use `pathlib.PurePath(name).suffix` for the extension (`PurePath` works like `Path` from lesson 3.05, but only with the name: it never touches the disk).
stretch: Make it real: point it at a test folder you made, and move the files with `Path.rename` only when the user types `yes`.
